item.title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
item.description: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels
item.description: Taiz, a city in southwestern Yemen, faces a severe water crisis as Houthi rebels backed by Iran tighten their encirclement. The city has struggled with water issues for over a decade, but the situation has worsened in recent weeks.

item.title: Flooding in Four Corners region displaces residents, as storms move southeast
item.description: Intense rainfall slammed the Four Corners region late this week. As rivers flooded, towns declared evacuations and emergencies and made rescues.

item.title: Israeli PM pledges massive military operation after West Bank checkpoint attack
item.description: Israel's Prime Minister is vowing to launch a major military operation in the West Bank in response to an attack by two Palestinian gunmen on an Israeli military checkpoint that killed two soldiers.
